name: Gaitz
personality: A seasoned duelist who loves Sai tea, Ferghanan horses, and calligraphy.
story: Gaitz is a veteran warrior from the eastern nation of Sai who fights in Bertrand's Army. He can only be recruited on Dietrich's route: Support 3, Renown 10+, complete Bertrand's Paralogue "Friendly Match with Brigid's King" (accept window 17/9-25/9), then the "They Have Lost" event around Chapter 12, after Bertrand's team is eliminated.

personalSkill.name: Brave Assist
personalSkill.effect: Grants Def +3 to adjacent allies. Lv 20: Flashing Fang (20% trigger: Atk +4, Hit +50); Lv 35: Flashing Fang+ (Atk +7, Hit +100).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A. KeenGamer: B (solid stats but very late, Dietrich-only arrival).

recruit.extra: Clear Bertrand's Paralogue AND Bertrand's team eliminated from tournament (~Ch12)
why: Only Dietrich's route can recruit Gaitz at all, so the choice makes itself.
recruit.tip: Also needs Bertrand's Paralogue and Bertrand's team knocked out of the tournament (around Ch 12).

build.notes: Joins at about Lv 25 (Ch 12), already in a Specialty class. If it isn't Armored Ornius Rider, take that exam at once (Riding D, Axe C, Spear C). Part III: Riding C for Elephant Rider (D-156). Master Sense Threat. Brave Assist gives adjacent allies Def +3. The video says wall-jumping Ornius classes have solid stats.
